setup.zh: 从兖州往东，路沿着潍水走。水往东流，流到头是海。岸上一个人在钓鱼，鱼钩是直的，也没有饵。
setup.en: East from Yan the road follows the Wei. The water runs east, and at its end is the sea. A man on the bank is fishing with a straight hook and no bait.

text.zh: 海在往里吸气。第三鼎——在海底下，它把潮水吸进去了。
text.en: The sea is breathing in. The third cauldron — under the sea. It has drawn the tide into itself.

alone.zh: 海在往里吸气。第三鼎在海底下，潮水正被吸进去。
alone.en: The sea is breathing in. The third cauldron lies beneath it, and the tide is being drawn inside.

text.zh: 钓鱼的人不看鱼，看海：东海的潮，四十九天没退了。要问路，去临淄。
text.en: The fisherman watches the sea, not the water: the tide of the East Sea has not gone out in forty-nine days. If you want the road, ask in Linzi.

exits.means: goes to the town, follows the river down, agrees to ask there

text.zh: 你沿潍水往下，再折向北。临淄的稷门外站满了人，都在听先生们吵架。
text.en: You follow the Wei down, then turn north. Outside Linzi's Ji Gate a crowd stands listening to the masters argue.

exits.means: asks the fisherman about the straight hook, talks to him, asks what he is fishing for

text.zh: 他说：钩直，饵无，愿者上钩。当年钓起齐国的那位太公，用的也是这样的钩。
text.en: He says: a straight hook and no bait — whoever is willing bites. The old duke who fished up the state of Qi used the same.
He isn't fishing for fish. Come.

alone.en: He is not fishing for fish.

exits.means: goes straight east to the sea now, tries to reach the shore directly

text.zh: 你往东走到海边。海面平得像镜子，不进也不退。远远有一座城浮在水上。
text.en: East to the shore. The sea lies flat as a mirror, neither in nor out. Far off, a city floats on the water.
That is no city. Linzi first.

alone.en: That is no city. Linzi lies west.
